name: getgroups32
description: getgroups32 returns the supplementary group IDs of the calling process, supporting 32-bit group IDs. It is a Linux-specific variant of getgroups for handling larger group ID values.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of items that can be stored in the buffer pointed to by list

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Buffer to hold the supplementary group IDs

return_value.success: Returns the number of supplementary group IDs
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: size is less than the number of supplementary group IDs, but is not zero
